title: Monetary System
description:
Currency Name: The Obelisk
Coin tiers: Bronze, silver, gold.

Tax Structure:
   - Lowlands: 10-20%, tied to inflation.
   - Highlands: 25% + luxury tax.
   - Merchants: 15% trade tithe, local trade tax-free.

Salary for council members: 200 Obelisks/week

The Garden Clause: Restriction on 100 Obelisks earned by Council Members to be invested in the Lowlands
*   Spending must be transactional and verifiable (Receipt of investment)
*   'Investment' is defined as: Construction materials, local food services, Lowlands artisans, or direct housing support.
*   The coin must enter the local circulation directly.
*   Failure to spend 50% results in the forfeiture of the unspent portion to the city's maintenance fund.

Salary for laborer: 100 Obelisks/week

The Black Market: The Undercage 20% tax, legal gambling.  

Indentured servitude with defined terms only. Slavery is illegal. (without consent)
author: Shuriira
